title: Kalman Filter and MCS Pipeline Disconnection in Conductor
evidence: In src/fetch_market_data.py lines 514, 562, 646: self.snapshot.kalman_state is initialized to default KalmanState() and risk_engine.run_kalman_filter() is never invoked. Conductor passes dominant_state='UNKNOWN' into RiskEngine.compute_multi_asset_kelly() and EntryEngine.score_entry(). Furthermore, compute_mcs is imported at line 41 but never called in Conductor.
blast_radius: Affects 26 downstream symbols. In live execution, regime-specific risk-off capital preservation is completely bypassed, resulting in unhedged equity drawdowns while the backtester (quantitative_backtester.py) executes Kalman and MCS properly.
remediation:
1. In src/fetch_market_data.py, invoke self.snapshot.kalman_state = self.risk_engine.run_kalman_filter(macro_features) prior to Kelly sizing.
2. Invoke compute_mcs(self.features_vector) and assign to self.snapshot.mcs.
3. Pass the resolved dominant_state to compute_multi_asset_kelly and score_entry.

title: Monolithic Conductor High-Fanout Orchestrator Bottleneck
evidence: src/fetch_market_data.py:86-180: Conductor directly instantiates 12 quantitative engines, 3 broker/data adapters, data lake persistence, and event bus in a single 1000+ line monolithic class with direct state mutations across all pipeline phases.
blast_radius: Tight coupling across entire system (>15 engines). Any schema or engine signature modification requires touching Conductor internals, creating high testing regression risk.
remediation: Decompose Conductor into distinct pipeline stages using a modular middleware or chain-of-responsibility pattern: IngestionStage, FeatureStage, InferenceStage, RiskStage, and ExecutionStage.

title: Configuration Mechanism Drift Between TradingTerminal and Conductor
evidence: TradingTerminal.jsx toggles tickers via GET/POST /api/trading_settings which reads/writes config/trading_settings.json (src/api.py:412-430). However, Conductor in fetch_market_data.py:103 reads active tickers from config/tickers.json and disabled tickers from data/state/trading_config.json.
blast_radius: User interactions in the trading terminal UI fail silently; live backend execution ignores trading_settings.json completely.
remediation: Unify configuration paths: refactor /api/trading_settings to read and write config/tickers.json and data/state/trading_config.json, or update Conductor to consume trading_settings.json.

title: Dead Functions in Feature Engine
evidence: AST queries in CodeGraph confirm zero call sites across the codebase for sign_snapshot_payload (line 73), check_mathematical_consistency (line 77), append_to_immutable_chain (line 90), compute_weekly_liquidity_boundaries (line 456), calculate_model_tvd (line 484), and calculate_bayesian_conditional_probability (line 516).
blast_radius: 6 unreferenced functions bloat codebase maintenance surface and confuse developers regarding active mathematical models.
remediation: Deprecate and remove dead functions from feature_engine.py; clean up unused imports in src/fetch_market_data.py.

title: Deprecated Legacy Modules and Orphaned Utilities
evidence: src/backtest.py has been superseded by src/quantitative_backtester.py; src/train_models.py trains an unused VotingClassifier superseded by src/training/train_models.py; tune_hyperparameters.py references non-existent config/api_keys.json.
blast_radius: 5 standalone files containing out-of-sync duplicate logic and incompatible configurations.
remediation: Move obsolete scripts to a legacy/ archive directory or delete them from source tree, updating documentation to point to active tools.

title: Unhandled Null/Undefined API Payload Vulnerabilities
evidence: OverviewTab.jsx:14 calls data.regime.replace(/_/g, ' ') and lines 106, 110 call data.decision.entry_score.toFixed(2); TradingTerminal.jsx:35 calls data.active_tickers.map(...); PaperTradingTab.jsx:134 dereferences portfolio.total_equity and lines 222, 246 evaluate portfolio.win_rate !== undefined (which evaluates to true for null), immediately executing (null).toFixed() and throwing TypeError.
blast_radius: A single null field or partial JSON response from FastAPI unmounts the entire React root tree, locking the user out of the dashboard.
remediation: Implement defensive optional chaining (?.) and default null-coalescing (??) across all numeric formatting, string transformations, and array iterations: (data?.regime ?? 'UNKNOWN').replace(), (portfolio?.win_rate ?? 0).toFixed(1).

title: Missing Error Boundary Coverage Across 6 Tabs and Root Shell
evidence: Only MacroTab, FundamentalTab, MathModelTab, and PipelineVisualizer are wrapped in ErrorBoundary. The App shell and 6 out of 10 tab views render without error boundaries in App.jsx lines 121-131.
blast_radius: Any runtime exception in 60% of tabs crashes the entire SPA into a blank white screen with no fallback UI or recovery action.
remediation: Wrap the main tab container and each individual tab view in ErrorBoundary with dedicated fallback recovery buttons.

title: WebSocket Telemetry Lifecycle Breakdown and Heartbeat State Eviction
evidence: PipelineVisualizer.jsx establishes native WebSocket with no onclose or onerror reconnect handlers. Heartbeats sent by src/api.py:75 ({"type": "heartbeat"}) pass data.component as undefined, causing setActiveComponent(undefined) (clearing SVG active node highlights) and appending heartbeats to logs array, evicting real pipeline logs from the 20-entry circular buffer.
blast_radius: Telemetry permanently dies on first network interruption; active pipeline visualizer nodes flicker off every 3 seconds.

title: Missing Development Reverse Proxy in Vite Configuration
evidence: frontend/vite.config.js contains plugins: [react()] with zero server proxy settings. In local dev (port 5173), fetch('/api/*') and WebSocket connections to ws://localhost:5173/api/ws/pipeline fail with 404 or connection refused.
blast_radius: Breaks local frontend development environment; frontend cannot communicate with backend without custom external Nginx proxy.
remediation: Add server.proxy configuration in vite.config.js mapping /api and /api/ws to http://localhost:8000 and ws://localhost:8000 with ws: true and changeOrigin: true.

title: Ghost CSS Classes and Collapsed Regime Progress Bars
evidence: Classes .text-plasma-green, .text-plasma-red, .text-plasma-cyan, .text-plasma-purple, .text-plasma-amber, .text-purple, .btn-primary, .btn-danger, .progress-bg, and .progress-fill do not exist in index.css. In MathModelTab.jsx lines 27-28, regime progress bars render at 0px height (invisible); buttons in ReportsTab render unstyled.
blast_radius: Core quantitative visual indicators (HMM regime probabilities) are completely invisible to traders; UI buttons lack affordance.
remediation: Define missing CSS classes in index.css: set .progress-bg with height: 6px and background; .progress-fill with height: 100%; implement .btn-primary and .btn-danger styling.

title: API Secret Key Input Missing from System Configuration UI
evidence: SettingsTab.jsx declares apiSecret state and saves to localStorage.setItem('quantos_api_key', apiSecret) at line 63, but completely omits an <input> element for apiSecret in JSX lines 85-136.
blast_radius: When backend QUANTOS_SECRET authentication is activated, users have no visual UI mechanism to configure credentials, permanently blocking manual trigger actions.
remediation: Add a password input field for QuantOS API Secret in SettingsTab.jsx bound to apiSecret and setApiSecret.

title: Cascading 1000ms Clock Re-Render Loop in Application Root
evidence: frontend/src/App.jsx lines 66-69 executes setInterval(..., 1000) modifying clock state in the root App component every second. Because child tabs are not memoized with React.memo, the entire active tab reconciles every second.
blast_radius: Continuous 1Hz virtual DOM re-evaluation causes CPU churn, battery drain, and unnecessary SVG/chart canvas reconciliations.
remediation: Extract the clock display into an isolated leaf component (<ClockDisplay timeZone={timeZone} />) with local state, removing clock state from App.jsx.

title: Global setInterval Variable Shadowing in TradingTerminal
evidence: frontend/src/components/TradingTerminal.jsx:23 declares const [interval, setInterval] = useState('D'), which shadows window.setInterval inside the component scope.
blast_radius: Any timer call inside TradingTerminal invokes the React state setter rather than window.setInterval, creating silent timer failures.
remediation: Rename state hook to const [chartInterval, setChartInterval] = useState('D').

title: Destructive Non-Atomic State Overwrite Hazards
evidence: paper_broker.py:56 writes paper_portfolio.json directly via open(self.portfolio_path, 'w') + json.dump; fundamental_agent/main.py:49 writes fundamental_scores.json via open(..., 'w'); api.py writes trading_config.json via open(..., 'w'). None of these use atomic tempfile+replace.
blast_radius: If process crashes or API reads file while being written, file is truncated to 0 bytes, permanently erasing paper trading cash, positions, and user trading configurations.
remediation: Implement centralized atomic_write_json utility utilizing tempfile.mkstemp, flush, os.fsync, and os.replace across all state writers.

title: Data Lake Parquet Schema Drift Across 70 Daily Files
evidence: Inspection of all 70 daily Parquet files in data/raw/ identifies 13 distinct schema signatures with column counts fluctuating from 161 to 212. Caused by unconstrained ticker additions and unordered column flattening of yfinance MultiIndex in lake_manager.py:35-36.
blast_radius: Vectorized analytics engines (PyArrow Dataset, DuckDB, Polars) fail with SchemaError when scanning across multiple partitions.
remediation: Enforce canonical sorted column ordering in LakeManager.save_tabular; implement schema backfilling and validation against a strict Pydantic/PyArrow schema.

title: Partition Directory Contamination Breaking Multi-File Dataset Scans
evidence: lake_manager.py writes both tabular Parquet files (raw_daily_ohlcv.parquet) and JSONL files (events.jsonl, market_snapshot.jsonl) into the exact same partition directory. pyarrow.dataset.dataset('data/raw', format='parquet') immediately crashes on events.jsonl.
blast_radius: Completely disables partition-wide SQL queries and parquet dataset ingestion pipelines.
remediation: Segregate tabular and unstructured datasets into distinct storage roots: data/raw/ohlcv/YYYY/MM/DD/ and data/raw/events/YYYY/MM/DD/.

title: JSONL Records Exceeding 4096B POSIX Atomic Append Boundary
evidence: lake_manager.py:89 appends serialized snapshots measuring up to 24,066 bytes using open(..., 'a'). POSIX guarantees write atomicity only up to PIPE_BUF (4,096 bytes). Concurrent appends split large records, corrupting JSONL syntax.
blast_radius: Corrupts market_snapshot.jsonl log streams under concurrent execution cycles, breaking downstream JSON parsers.
remediation: Protect JSONL appends with fcntl.flock on a dedicated log lock file, or buffer writes through a synchronized queue.

title: Write-Only 'Black Hole' Data Lake Anti-Pattern
evidence: LakeManager writes Parquet partitions on every execution cycle, but no module in QuantOS ever reads from the Parquet data lake. fetch_market_data.py and quantitative_backtester.py repeatedly download historical bars from external APIs over the network.
blast_radius: Consumes disk I/O and storage without operational utility; leaves entire system vulnerable to external API rate limits and network outages.
remediation: Refactor YahooAdapter and Backtester to implement a read-through local cache that queries local Parquet partitions before issuing network requests.

title: Partial Atomic Write Utility Lacking fsync Flush
evidence: atomic_json_write in fetch_market_data.py:48-61 writes tempfile and executes os.replace without calling f.flush() and os.fsync(fd). In POSIX filesystems, directory entry rename can commit before dirty page cache blocks are flushed.
blast_radius: Sudden process termination, power loss, or OS crash can leave a 0-byte or corrupted file at destination path.
remediation: Add f.flush() and os.fsync(f.fileno()) immediately prior to os.replace.

title: Concurrency Collision Between Market Monitor and Scheduled Cron
evidence: scheduler.py protects scheduled jobs with execution.lock via fcntl.flock. However, market_monitor.py:112 executes subprocess.run(['python3', 'src/fetch_market_data.py', '--interval', '1h']) upon volatility or stop loss triggers WITHOUT acquiring execution.lock.
blast_radius: Dual concurrent execution of fetch_market_data.py collides on paper_portfolio.json, paper_ledger.csv, and Parquet files, causing duplicate orders, double-spent cash, and data corruption.
remediation: Refactor market_monitor.py to invoke fetch_market_data.py via run_locked_subprocess with non-blocking check and exponential backoff retry.

title: Unbounded Blocking Wait and Mutex Truncation on Open
evidence: run_locked_subprocess opens lock_file with open(lock_path, 'w') which truncates the lockfile inode while held by another process. Furthermore, fcntl.flock(lock_file, fcntl.LOCK_EX) blocks indefinitely with no timeout.
blast_radius: A hung network request in a child process blocks the APScheduler worker thread permanently, exhausting the 10-worker pool and freezing the entire automation engine.
remediation: Open lock file in append mode ('a'); add subprocess.run(timeout=600); implement non-blocking lock acquisition with retry timeout.

title: Scheduler Child Process Failure Suppression and Blind Cascade
evidence: run_locked_subprocess executes subprocess.run(args) with default check=False and ignores returncode. In run_4h, if fetch_market_data.py exits with error code 1, the scheduler immediately executes build_report.py and _apply_adaptive_frequency() against missing or stale state.
blast_radius: Errors are silently masked; misleading reports are generated; cadence adaptation acts on stale data.
remediation: Check completed_process.returncode == 0; raise RuntimeError or log alert and abort downstream report generation and frequency adaptation on failure.

title: Broken Mutex Boundary on Report Generation
evidence: In run_4h and run_1d, execution.lock is released immediately after fetch_market_data.py completes. build_report.py is executed outside the lock, allowing a newly triggered 1H job to rewrite snapshot files while build_report is reading them.
blast_radius: Race condition corrupts generated markdown execution reports and visual maps.
remediation: Extend execution.lock context to encapsulate both fetch_market_data.py and build_report.py.

title: Adaptive Frequency Rapid Execution Cascade
evidence: In scheduler.py:71-100, when frequency changes, the job is re-added with next_run_time=datetime.now(), forcing immediate execution. If market metrics oscillate, this triggers rapid back-to-back pipeline executions.
blast_radius: Spams external market APIs (Yahoo Finance, Fred), exhausts rate limits, and spikes CPU usage.
remediation: Calculate next regular cron interval for newly selected cadence instead of forcing immediate execution.

title: Frequency Controller Hard-Cap at 4H Disconnecting 1H Mode
evidence: src/engines/frequency_controller.py:90-98 hard-caps recommended execution frequency at '4h' even for maximum volatility scores. Consequently, the '1h' branch in scheduler.py:87-90 is unreachable dead code in production.
blast_radius: Intra-cycle 1H execution mode is disabled despite scheduler support, preventing agile risk reallocation during extreme volatility events.
remediation: Update frequency_controller.py: if score >= 4 and enable_1h_mode: return '1h'.
